title: Microsoft Teams: admin recommendations to enable agents and apps for applications already in use
summary: The briefing accurately reports the optional enablement, rollout window and unchanged existing settings in Microsoft's notice. The documented app-management paths and PowerShell parameters are supported; clarify the alternative commands and the limits of the org-wide third-party apps control.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No setting label, navigation path, PowerShell command or Graph equivalent for enabling or disabling this recommendations feature is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center recommendations existing applications enable disable feature PowerShell Graph configuration; "app recommendations" "Teams". Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-apps, /app-centric-management and /powershell/module/microsoftteams/update-m365teamsapp.

claims.claim: Per-app availability is managed in Teams admin center at Teams apps > Manage apps > app > Users and groups > Availability > Edit availability.
claims.quote: Go to the Manage apps page. Search for the required app and select the app name to open its app details page. Select the Users and groups tab. ... select Availability. Select Edit availability.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app ID> -AppAssignmentType Everyone sets per-app availability to Everyone.
claims.quote: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone
claims.fix: Show the two alternatives as separate complete calls rather than joining them with '; or'. Use 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app ID> -AppAssignmentType Everyone' and 'Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app ID> -AppAssignmentType UsersAndGroups -OperationType Add -Users <users> -Groups <groups>', matching the reference examples.

claims.claim: The MicrosoftTeams module's Update-M365TeamsApp supports UsersAndGroups assignment with OperationType Add, Users and Groups.
claims.quote: -AppAssignmentType UsersAndGroups -OperationType Add -Users eec823bd-0979-4cf8-9924-85bb6ffcb57d, eec823bd-0979-4cf8-9924-85bb6ffcb57e -Groups 37da2d58-fc14-453e-9a14-5065ebd63a1d

claims.claim: Learn identifies Teams Administrator as the role needed to use Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To use Teams admin center, you must have a Teams Administrator role. Some admins with a higher privilege role can accomplish agent and app governance tasks but we recommend using the lower privilege role where possible.

claims.claim: Before unified app management migration, apps and agents must be allowed in Teams admin center and Microsoft 365 admin center > Integrated apps.
claims.quote: If your organization isn't migrated to unified app management, allow apps and Copilot agents in Teams admin center and under the Integrated apps page in Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: After unified app management migration, allowing an app or agent in either admin centre is enough.
claims.quote: If your organization is migrated to unified app management, allow apps and Copilot agents in Teams admin center or under the Integrated apps page in Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: controls[1].note; controls[2].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed the new recommendations workflow's integration with the existing app-management controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center recommendations existing applications enable disable feature PowerShell Graph configuration; "app recommendations" "Teams". Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-apps and /app-centric-management; read MC1481316, which does not identify those controls.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The org-wide third-party apps control is at Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Actions > Org-wide app settings > Third-party apps.
claims.quote: On Manage apps page, under the Actions menu, select Org-wide app settings. You can then configure the settings in the pane. ... Under Third-party apps, a single control manages the bulk availability of both the new and existing third-party agents and apps.

claims.where: controls[2].governs and note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The existing Third-party apps toggle manages bulk availability of third-party agents and apps.
claims.quote: This control doesn't override app-level configurations. The Org-wide app settings don't apply to: All apps that have user assignment set to Specific users and groups and saved by you.
claims.fix: Add to controls[2].note and the surrounding explanation: 'Under app-centric management, this default applies to new and unmanaged apps; it does not override saved per-app assignments or blocked apps.' The qualification is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/app-centric-management#default-settings-for-app-availability.

claims.claim: No PowerShell cmdlet or other automation equivalent for the org-wide Third-party apps toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "third-party apps" "org-wide" "cmdlet"; "Teams" "org-wide app settings" "Graph". Read learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-apps, /app-centric-management, Graph teamsAppSettings and Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration search excerpts; no equivalent toggle.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Per-app availability set to Everyone includes all organisation users, new users and guests.
claims.quote: Everyone | Available to all org users, new users, and guests.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Specific users or groups permits selected users and groups but excludes guests even if assigned.
claims.quote: Only the users and groups that you select can use the app. ... Guests can't use the app if this option is selected and even if guests are assigned to the app.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: App availability changes take up to 24 hours to take effect.
claims.quote: It takes up to 24 hours for the availability changes to take effect.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: In rare cases availability changes take up to six days to appear in the client.
claims.quote: In rare cases, it might take up to six days for the changes to reflect in the client.
